info.name: Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network API

params.name: configId
params.description: The datastream ID. The v1 APIs use configId instead of datastreamId.

params.name: requestId
params.description:
Provide an external request tracing ID; it can also be supplied in the x-request-id header.
The Edge Network always appends a 16-character hex entropy suffix to the provided value (or generates a new UUID if none is provided) to guarantee uniqueness across concurrent requests.
The returned identifier uses the format `<requestId>-<entropy>` (for example, `708e4f90-5bff-41c5-8f4b-6c15bab76b11-f46e48eb52594815`).
Because the entropy suffix is always added, the value in the response always differs from the value supplied in the request. When correlating requests to responses, match on the prefix of the returned requestId rather than an exact string match.

params.name: silent
params.description:
Optional boolean parameter indicating whether the API returns 204 No Content with an empty payload or not.
Critical errors are reported using the corresponding HTTP Status Code and payload, however.
Applicable to /v2/collect API only.
